convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom with 'ColorZeroLAG_MA' custom indicator and two external .mqh includes (SmoothAlgorithms.mqh, TradeAlgorithms.mqh). The custom indicator and library functions (GetStartBars, BuyPositionOpen, etc.) require manual Python reimplementation.

derived_values.name: ZeroLAG MA value at SignalBar
derived_values.formula: CopyBuffer(InpInd_Handle, buffer_index=0, start_pos=SignalBar, count=3) → Value[0]=current, Value[1]=SignalBar, Value[2]=SignalBar+1

other_exits: Buy position closed when ColorZeroLAG_MA[SignalBar] > ColorZeroLAG_MA[SignalBar+1] (downtrend detected) and BuyPosClose input is true
Sell position closed when ColorZeroLAG_MA[SignalBar] < ColorZeroLAG_MA[SignalBar+1] (uptrend detected) and SellPosClose input is true

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MM input (0.1) interpreted according to MMMode enum; LOT mode means fixed lot size of 0.1

custom_logic_notes: ColorZeroLAG_MA is a zero-lag moving average composed of two MAs with different methods (SMA period 12 and JJMA period 5). The indicator changes color based on slope direction. Signal logic: Value[1]<Value[2] means MA is rising (uptrend); Value[0]>Value[1] confirms acceleration → buy. Value[1]>Value[2] means MA is falling (downtrend); Value[0]<Value[1] confirms acceleration → sell. Entry gates BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen and exit gates BuyPosClose/SellPosClose are configurable. The EA uses TradeAlgorithms.mqh library functions (BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose, GlobalVariableDel_) which encapsulate order sending logic. SmoothAlgorithms.mqh provides GetStartBars() for minimum history calculation and the JJMA/other smooth method implementations used by the custom indicator.
python_conversion_notes: Must reimplement ColorZeroLAG_MA indicator in Python: it combines two smoothed MAs (SMA-12 and JJMA-5) to produce a zero-lag composite. JJMA (JMA) is a Jurik moving average - need to port the algorithm or use a Python equivalent (e.g., from ta-lib or custom Jurik implementation). The Phase parameters (-100 to +100) control JJMA smoothness. Trade logic is straightforward: compare 3 consecutive MA values for slope and acceleration. Position sizing uses TradeAlgorithms.mqh which supports 5 margin modes; LOT mode (default) = fixed 0.1 lot. StopLoss/TakeProfit are in points (1000/2000 = 100/200 pips at 5-digit broker). New bar guard via CIsNewBar class ensures one signal evaluation per bar.
